# PrepScholar Blog

> > Expert guidance on standardized test preparation (SAT, ACT, PSAT, AP, IB, TOEFL) and college admissions strategies.

PrepScholar Blog provides comprehensive test prep strategies, college application advice, scholarship opportunities, and admissions guidance. Written by education experts including Christine Sarikas, Melissa Brinks, Mary Ann Barge, Justin Berkman, and Rebecca Safier, the blog covers everything from SAT/ACT study plans to college essays and financial aid.

## Key Topics

- SAT preparation and test strategies
- ACT test prep and study guides
- College admissions and application essays
- Standardized testing (PSAT, AP, IB, TOEFL)
- Scholarship opportunities and financial aid
- College Board policies and procedures
- Test-taking strategies and study schedules
- Supplemental essays (Caltech, etc.)
- CEEB codes and test registration
- Transfer admissions
- Parent brag sheets and recommendations
- IB Math study guides
- Grammar and parts of speech
- Khan Academy SAT prep
- LGBTQ+ college resources

## SAT Preparation and Strategy

- [Why do you need to prep for the SAT?](https://blog.prepscholar.com/why-do-you-need-to-prep-for-the-sat): Explains importance and benefits of SAT test preparation
- [How to Build an SAT Study Plan: 4 Sample Schedules](https://blog.prepscholar.com/sat-study-plan): Four customizable SAT study schedules with planning guidance
- [What Is Khan Academy SAT Prep? How Can It Help You?](https://blog.prepscholar.com/khan-academy-sat): Overview of Khan Academy's free SAT prep partnership with College Board
- [Overall SAT Structure](https://blog.prepscholar.com/sat-overall-structure): Overview of SAT test sections and format structure
- [Complete Parts of Speech for SAT Writing and ACT English](https://blog.prepscholar.com/complete-list-parts-of-speech-for-sat-writing-and-act-english): Complete grammar reference covering parts of speech for SAT/ACT tests

## ACT Test Preparation

- [How to Answer ACT Reading Questions: 5-Step Guide](https://blog.prepscholar.com/how-to-answer-act-reading-questions): Five-step strategy guide for approaching ACT Reading questions
- [Class of 2017: Skip the new SAT and take the ACT?](https://blog.prepscholar.com/class-of-2017-skip-the-new-sat-and-take-the-act): Analysis of SAT vs ACT strategy for Class of 2017 amid SAT redesign

## Scholarships and Financial Aid

- [Guaranteed Scholarships Based on SAT/ACT Scores](https://blog.prepscholar.com/guaranteed-scholarships-based-on-sat-act-scores): Detailed list of automatic scholarships based on SAT/ACT test scores
- [12 Amazing Full-Ride Scholarships You Can Win](https://blog.prepscholar.com/full-ride-scholarships-you-can-win): List of 12 full-ride scholarships from private institutions open to all

## College Admissions and Applications

- [How to Write Amazing Caltech Essays](https://blog.prepscholar.com/caltech-essays-supplement): In-depth analysis and tips for writing standout Caltech supplement essays
- [What Is a Parent Brag Sheet? Tips and Examples](https://blog.prepscholar.com/high-school-parent-brag-sheet-example): Guide for parents on creating brag sheets for college recommendations
- [College Transfer Acceptance Rates: Which Schools Accept the Most Students?](https://blog.prepscholar.com/college-transfer-acceptance-rates): Transfer acceptance rates at popular and selective colleges
- [The Most LGBTQ+ Friendly Colleges in The Country](https://blog.prepscholar.com/lgbt-friendly-colleges): List of most LGBTQ+ inclusive and friendly colleges nationwide

## Test Registration and Logistics

## Advanced Coursework and IB
